newsitem.title: USA: Watsco files for 3 million common shares.
newsitem.headline: Watsco files for 3 million common shares.

text.p: Watsco Inc said Wedensday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to three million common shares.
The company has offered the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 450,000 additional common shares. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 17,040,329 common.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Prudential Securities Inc, Smith Barney Inc and Robert W. Baird & Co Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to fund acquisitions and repay indebtedness, the filing said.
The company, based in Coconut Grove, Fla., is a distributor of residential central air conditioners in the United States.
